research_question: What is the effect of live attenuated herpes zoster vaccine (Oka/Merck zoster vaccine, Zostavax), compared with placebo, on the occurrence of adverse events in adults aged 50 years or older?
outcome_description: Number of participants who experienced one or more adverse events of any type (injection-site or systemic, vaccine-related or not) during the short-term post-vaccination safety follow-up period out of the total number randomised or vaccinated in each arm.
positive_direction: Fewer participants experiencing adverse events in the vaccine group compared with the placebo group (favoring vaccine).
search_queries: live attenuated herpes zoster vaccine zostavax placebo adverse events randomized trial
oka merck zoster vaccine safety tolerability controlled trial quantitative outcome
herpes zoster vaccine placebo randomized clinical trial adverse effects comparison
inclusion_criteria: Randomised placebo-controlled trials evaluating live attenuated herpes zoster vaccine (Oka/Merck, Zostavax) in adults aged 50 years or older.

Studies reporting the number of participants experiencing one or more adverse events of any type (injection-site or systemic, vaccine-related or not) during short-term post-vaccination safety follow-up.
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, narrative reviews, editorials, commentaries, and conference abstracts without quantitative data).

No comparison between live attenuated zoster vaccine and placebo (e.g. trials evaluating recombinant subunit zoster vaccine [Shingrix], head-to-head comparisons of different active vaccines, or single-arm non-comparative studies).
No extractable quantitative outcome data on adverse events (missing counts or proportions of participants with adverse events).
Completely unrelated to live attenuated herpes zoster vaccination or safety outcomes in adults aged 50 years or older.
moderators_to_extract: Participant age group / mean age (e.g., 50-59 years vs 60+ years)
Safety follow-up duration (e.g., days 0-28 vs days 0-42 post-vaccination)
Safety cohort type (substudy cohort vs total randomised trial population)
Vaccine potency / dose (potency level in plaque-forming units)
effect_size_note: Risk ratio (RR) pooled using a random-effects model. An RR > 1 indicates a higher risk of adverse events in the live attenuated zoster vaccine group compared with placebo.
